status: Draft workload plan; final source pair and per-arm semantic outputs must be frozen before sampling
extraction_limit: root-scale is an extraction/work-sharing stress control without a consuming call; it does not establish downstream query performance

graph.semantics: pin independently verified full graph reports before timing; physical-site count is only a stable timing signature

effects.semantics: run verify mode with one iteration per arm; review exact target/caller/site changes before timing

diagnostics_limit: observer mode measures the public library observer; it excludes CLI stderr delivery/rendering and must not be described as full CLI diagnostic overhead
controls: retain the existing fixed eight-case1972 controls without modifying their inputs or batch rules
report: fixed batch selection rules before long samples
no favorable retry or outlier deletion
exact final source and binary hashes
gate: reproduced representative regressions block publication; count or layout equality does not establish speed or memory neutrality
